before.content:
cold_exit_code=$?
set -e
cat "$cold_stdout" >> "$root/output/performance-result.ndjson"
test "$cold_exit_code" = 0
cold_p95=$(sed -n 's/^STAGE6_COLD_READY_P95_MILLIS=//p' "$cold_stdout")
case "$cold_p95" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 1;; esac

after.content:
cold_exit_code=$?
set -e
cat "$cold_stdout" >> "$root/output/performance-result.ndjson"
# Process/measurement failures remain blocking. An honestly recorded p95 above the 8s target is advisory.
test "$cold_exit_code" = 0
cold_p95=$(sed -n 's/^STAGE6_COLD_READY_P95_MILLIS=//p' "$cold_stdout")
case "$cold_p95" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 1;; esac
